bullets.text: In Chennai, a youth named Manoj was injured after his bike crashed into a getaway van while chasing cattle thieves, and the office should monitor police investigations.
A netizen responded to Minister R. Kumar asking for similar speed in widening the Velachery-Tambaram road as the new Sathankulam-Nazareth state highway.
The Greater Chennai Corporation reviewed stormwater drainage and canal works, including widening the Okkiyam Maduvu Canal in Adyar and Sholinganallur zones for monsoon readiness.
Karambakkam residents questioned GCC and the revenue department regarding the construction of a PDS shop on a site classified as a pond.
A court ordered Rs. 1.70 crore in compensation for a Pallikaranai woman who went into a coma following an accident in Chennai.
Out-of-state omni buses blocked routes by parking across the state border checkpoint near Gummidipoondi, causing a traffic disruption that the district team must watch.
Prime Minister Modi is scheduled to visit Chennai to launch the ready Poonamallee to Vadapalani metro rail service, and the district team should track the visit.
Collector Kavitha stated that 134 government buses are operating in Thiruvallur under the Chief Minister's Vetri Payanam scheme, which the office should note.
The PanIIT AP Summit 2026 in Vijayawada will spotlight DeepTech, AI, innovation, and quantum computing, and the portfolio team should monitor the deliberations.
Soumya Anbumani stated that they will pressure the government to gradually reduce liquor shops to create a liquor-free state, which the office should watch.
GK Vasan stated that TVK has a high chance of winning the upcoming by-elections for the Dharapuram and Madurantakam assembly constituencies.
